stem.text: Which description is correct for collagen?

A.text: A collagen molecule has a high proportion of the amino acid glycine, which has a very small R group.

B.text: A group of three collagen fibres forms a strong, insoluble coiled structure termed a triple helix.

C.text: Each of the collagen polypeptides in a collagen molecule has a regular spiral arrangement of many alpha helices.

D.text: Peptide bonds are present between amino acids of the different polypeptides forming the collagen molecule.
